title: The Law of Leprosy in a House
description: The Lord gives Moses and Aaron instructions on how to handle houses in Canaan affected by a leprosy-like infection. The owner must report it to the priest, who inspects the house, seals it for seven days, removes infected stones, scrapes the walls, and replasters them. If the infection returns, the house must be demolished and its debris taken outside the city. If the house is healed, it is cleansed with two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop, and the priest makes atonement for the house.
